SQL_STMT_U.val: SELECT SUM(COALESCE(rf.previous_balance,0)) AS TotalPreviousBalance, SUM(COALESCE(rf.reduced_sales_amount,0) + COALESCE(rf.standard_sales_amount,0)) AS TotalSales, SUM(COALESCE(rf.reduced_return_amount,0) + COALESCE(rf.standard_return_amount,0)) AS TotalReturns, SUM(COALESCE(rf.reduced_discount_amount,0) + COALESCE(rf.standard_discount_amount,0)) AS TotalDiscounts, SUM(COALESCE(rf.reduced_tax_amount,0) + COALESCE(rf.standard_tax_amount,0)) AS TotalTax, SUM(COALESCE(rf.payment_amount,0)) AS TotalPayments, SUM(COALESCE(rf.current_balance,0)) AS TotalCurrentBalance FROM receivables_file AS rf WHERE rf.year_month = ':1' AND ( :2 = 0 OR rf.customer_id = :2 );
DELETE FROM receivables_file AS rf WHERE rf.year_month = ':1' AND ( :2 = 0 OR rf.customer_id = :2 OR rf.customer_id IN ( SELECT cm.id FROM customer cm WHERE cm.billing_customer_id = :2 ) );
